scenes.summary: You find the scroll content to be based on an actual location, a stark contrast to what Lady Si usually paints.

lines.text: There are some hoofprints on the ground...
You look a little surprised.
After seeing Dijiang floating above a mountain, this realistic piece feels a bit unfamiliar...
Lady Si wouldn't invest so much effort in every work.
This looks like an actual place in the real world... Any ideas?
It's familiar, but I can't recall where, yet.
Then let's follow.

scenes.summary: You find things that an evaccing HAS soldier left behind, and learn that the painting depicts a historical battle.

lines.text: The supplies and the terminal... They belonged to HAS soldiers.
Initially ... I thought it was just an abandoned village or town...
From the signs I see, they successfully evacuated to this place, and held a short celebration of their survival.
It's a relief to know that plenty of my comrades survived...
What's on your mind?
If we press on, we'll arrive at the actual battlefield... It seems Lady Si has decided for me.
Hmm. We have no reason for turning back.
HAS has fought numerous battles. I don't know which of them Si was trying to paint...
We know little about this battlefield, and the burdenbeast has charged right in. I'm a bit worried.
That's ... not what I actually meant.
Whatever this is, we can only keep going.
There. I believe it went that way.

scenes.summary: You discover that the war portrayed in the scroll is the same expedition that forced you into slumber ten years ago. At the time, Ye Minghe was a candidate for the Imperial Guards, serving with the HAS expedition unit. Locked in a brutal fight against hordes of Aggeloi, they had no choice but to relocate.

lines.text: Endfield ... the expedition...
You guessed correctly. This happened before your hibernation.
Ten years ago, anomalies were detected within the northern Aurora. Endfield urgently contacted all factions to initiate an expedition.
When we went our separate ways at Yuanyuan Manor, you said that you took part in that expedition.
Yes. I started my military career early, and earned a few commendations, thanks to Tianshi Tan's recognition. Ten years ago, I was an Imperial Guards reservist under probation...
Joining the HAS expeditionary force seemed like a natural choice.
My comrades and I understood the cruelty in the fields of war, but we underestimated the intensity of the expedition.
We made a few gains. But our new camp quickly came under retaliatory assaults by the Aggeloid host.
The Ankhors fell like rain. The Aggeloi were beyond counting, as though the Aurora itself flooded the lands...
From what we saw of the evac along the way, HAS managed to redeploy its forces in time.
Yes. The Tianshi made the call.
Strangely, the Aggeloi did not give chase. I thought they were merciless...
The damage to the bridge doesn't look like the work of the Aggeloi...
What are you looking at?
Nothing... The battlefield is messier than I thought. We must find that burdenbeast quickly.

scenes.summary: Both of you saw Ye Minghe from 10 years ago. He covered the evacuation on his own so that his fellow comrades could live. But he was trapped. He asks you to help repair the scroll to witness what happened afterwards.

lines.text: The solo rearguard they've been talking about ... it really is you.
Endmin, you've known for quite a while, haven't you?
That bridge we walked past... It was obviously sabotaged...
You know, I've seen you fight with sword and spear.
Furthermore, Si probably wasn't part of the expedition. If she could depict a battle, someone must have told her about it.
And holding a conversation with Si, that takes real talent.
I guess I can't hide anything from you.
But why? The soldiers have already evacuated. Why destroy your only retreat?
One single sacrifice for my comrades' lives and the HAS's final victory. A fair trade.
"He" has answered it for me.
Just one soldier for the rearguard? That doesn't sound like HAS.
It was my own decision.
I was young and rash. Perhaps the decision wasn't wrong in itself, but some of my ideas were foolish.
And I thus placed myself on hopeless ground.
I think I know what happened next...
From what I see, Si's painting has been damaged. That's why your "past self" is trapped and can't progress.
So, what now? Do we keep looking?
That's kind of you, but the past is the past. There is nothing to hide.
Also, our encounter happened soon afterwards... I was looking for a good time to tell you about it.
Endmin, pray use the brush and restore the painting. Let "my past self" do what he wants.
I see.
What's that...?

scenes.summary: You suddenly realize what Ye Minghe meant when he said he owes you his life. Just as you are about to go deeper, the missing burdenbeast suddenly appears. You decide to send it back to the Tianshi.

lines.text: The content of the painting ends here...
Now I see it. This is what you meant, when you said you owed me for saving your life.
Yes... But it's more than that.
If you hadn't been there, I would have died. For ten years, I've been thinking about your strike that tore the skies apart.
But what you gave me goes far beyond —
I almost forgot why we entered the painting...
This maverick hid really well, and only came out when we were about to leave it here...
Endmin, I think our burdenbeast has found the exit.
Maybe we should take it back to our Tianshi friend first? We can talk about the rest later.
Okay.

scenes.summary: You hand the burdenbeast to the Tianshi. From the conversation that followed, you learn that Ye Minghe stayed at a village to recover from his wounds. The Tianshi also came from that village. You are certain Si would depict more about Ye Minghe's past. Suddenly, one burdenbeast turns into an ink spirit and leads you to another place.

lines.text: Hey! Easy, easy! You were so nice around them. Or do you treat me like a pushover?
Certainly.
So you chose to major in burdenbeast rearing instead of becoming a "legendary warrior"?
Hah. You still remember my boast, Mister Minghe.
Well, you see Endmin, I grew up in a tiny village in the north...
But I didn't want to stay there. I wanted to be something. To prove myself. And then a wounded Mister Minghe arrived.
Impressive herd. Did you raise them all?
Yeah. But I'm losing my authority over them!
I just took some tartpeppers and ran around for a while. And guess what? I couldn't even bait a single burdenbeast...
Mister Minghe, Endmin! Thank you so much!
Must I admit that Mister Minghe is the better burdenbeast rancher?
Please don't say that.
Everything I know about burdenbeasts, I learned from you ... my mentor.
I don't know if that's a compliment or what...
Whatever. My project will succeed! I'll develop a feed mix that burdenbeasts truly crave!
You two...
Sounds like you've been through a lot, after that hard battle.
Si's painting ended abruptly. I'm actually curious what happened after our past encounter...
Lady Si can be quite free-spirited. She probably quit painting when she got bored with my story.
But from what I know about you, I have a feeling that the real story happened afterwards.
If you're interested, I'll just share it with you.
Heh. I know what happened too. I can totally help with the details...
Maybe it won't be necessary. I think Si must've made a painting of it.
You're right. Lady Si paints, and we follow.
My comrades ... have all evac'ed. Now I'm the last banner ... of HAS left in the field.
Reposition now and plot another route...
Final group is exiting the base. Evac is nearing seventy percent now...
Get to the valley in the back. It's the only safe place to rest...
Finally...
Got ... enough fight in you?
If you're ready, let's leave this place.

options: I still have to take care of something...

lines.text: A minor obstacle... Endmin, please stand back.
COME!
We have to reach the other side to keep going...
Let's skip the detours, and take a more direct route.
